class.name: NetwPredictStats
class.brief_description: Prediction counters for one [NetwEntity], reached by [member NetwPrediction.stats].
class.description: Use these for debug overlays and charts. To react to a correction, connect to the [NetwPrediction] signals. [codeblock] var stats := NetwEntity.of(self).prediction.stats print("%d corrections" % stats.corrections) [/codeblock]

members.member: Times this entity's prediction disagreed with the server and was corrected since spawn.
Times the server's state was written onto this entity since spawn, while this peer simulates it without controlling it.
